title: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src
lede: The source repo for Modern Web Guidance, a set of agent skills that feed current web platform practice and browser support data to coding agents so they stop reaching for legacy front-end patterns.

points: A CLI returns curated guides into the agent's context, steering it toward native browser APIs over heavy JavaScript and polyfills.
Covers about 250 web features and 203 developer use cases, from container queries and anchor positioning to on-device AI APIs.
Guides are pruned with evals to drop what models already know, keeping them token-efficient.
A legacy-scan command flags outdated patterns in an existing codebase.
Stewarded by the Chrome, Edge, Firefox and MDN teams together with the wider community.
